summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US analogue of an 8-K) containing only its third-quarter 2026 Management Discussion & Analysis and condensed parent-company and consolidated financial statements prepared under BRGAAP, plus the independent auditor's report. No transaction, stakeholder, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date is disclosed; recurring managerial result was R$12,617 million for 3Q26 with a 23.6% annualized return on average equity. This is routine quarterly reporting, not a special situation; watch only for periodic earnings and capital-ratio updates.
